definitions.explanation: The act of responding to or dealing with customers, visitors, or inquiries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{応対|おうたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
⟦お{客|きゃく}さま→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{応対|おうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She's good at dealing with customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{応対|おうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雑|ざつ}→雑：14582_zatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I was busy and my handling became sloppy.

notes:
USAGE: {応対|おうたい} focuses on how one responds to or deals with people, often emphasizing manner and quality of interaction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {応対|おうたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deal with, to respond to)
- {応対|おうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad service)
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧{応対|おうたい} (telephone reception)
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧{応対|おうたい} (counter service)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応接|おうせつ}→応接：04109_ousetsu⟧ - receiving guests (more formal, hospitality)
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ - response, handling (broader, includes non-personal situations)
- ⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧ - customer service
